reason: Radix AvatarImage (until loaded) and AvatarFallback with delayMs (until the delay elapses) render nothing, but the client must later mount them with their server-known attributes; the port keeps them in an inert <template> placeholder (no data-slot, no classes, not in the a11y tree or the parity snapshot) at their JSX position. Once mounted the DOM equals React's.
